note: API list prices in USD per million tokens, for the autonomy scorecard's dollars (npm run autonomy; docs/AUTONOMY.md). A model is priced by its own key, else its tool's key, else the family it names ('claude-opus-4-5' -> 'opus'). Cache writes are priced from the multipliers below (5-minute writes 1.25x input, 1-hour writes 2x) unless a row sets cacheWrite5m / cacheWrite1h itself. A session whose tool reported its own cost (Claude Code's total_cost_usd) counts at that cost. These defaults are PLACEHOLDERS from the last list prices the harness knew: compare them with the provider's price page (anthropic.com/pricing), fix any that differ (older or newer models of a family can cost more: add a row under the full model id), and set "checked" to the date you compared. Until then the card says the prices are unverified.
